Package com.skyblockexp.ezframework.command

Class CommandBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.skyblockexp.ezframework.command.CommandBuilder
public final class CommandBuilder extends Object
Lightweight builder for creating quick `EzCmd` instances for examples and small commands. This is a convenience helper; the preferred approach for production code is to create a dedicated class that extends `EzCmd`.
